Changed population and ascertainment prevent treating phase2b and phase3 as identical assays; the negative primary result still limits broad efficacy claims.
Nominal secondary or virus-specific trends are not confirmed clinical efficacy after gatekeeping failed.
Primary-source interpretation only: no raw-data replay, laboratory reproduction, independent scientific review, universal causal weight, minimal organism or numerical construction rule is admitted.
studies.observable: Clinically symptomatic respiratory illness under intention-to-treat analysis
studies.preparation: 1,024 adults aged at least65 in New Zealand/Australia were randomized to RTB101 10mg once daily or placebo for sixteen weeks, with four-week off-drug follow-up. Unlike phase2b, smokers/COPD were excluded and the primary endpoint was clinically symptomatic respiratory illness irrespective of laboratory confirmation.
reviewedLocators: Methods and Results: independent phase 3 trial, changed population/clinical endpoint, 16-week outcomes and adverse events
